title: Coordenador de Estratégia em Crédito Consignado Público - Campinas/SP
description:
Modelo de trabalho: Presencial. Local: Campinas/SP.

Responsabilidades

Responsável por liderar a definição, revisão e implementação das políticas de crédito para produtos de crédito consignado, garantindol equilíbrio entre crescimento sustentável da carteira, rentabilidade e controle de risco, em total aderência às diretrizes regulatórias e estratégicas da instituição.

  • Desenvolver, revisar e implementar políticas de crédito data-driven para consignado privado, assegurando evolução dos principais KPIs de risco e performance.
  • Coordenar a definição, acompanhamento e melhoria contínua dos indicadores estratégicos da carteira (inadimplência, NPL, PDD, perda esperada, vintages, aprovação e rentabilidade).
  • Definir e aprimorar regras de elegibilidade, limites de crédito, critérios de aprovação, cortes de risco e estratégias de concessão.
  • Monitorar o comportamento da carteira e antecipar tendências de mercado, mudanças regulatórias e padrões de risco, propondo ajustes estratégicos em políticas e modelos.
  • Liderar estudos analíticos (score, segmentação, testes e simulações de políticas), garantindo qualidade metodológica e aderência às melhores práticas de mercado.
  • Atuar como líder técnico da área, orientando analistas e especialistas e fomentando cultura analítica, inovação e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com as áreas de Risco, Produtos, Comercial, Compliance, Operações e Tecnologia para implementação e automação das decisões de crédito.
  • Coordenar iniciativas e projetos de melhoria contínua dos processos e políticas de crédito.
  • Representar a área de crédito em comitês, fóruns decisórios e apoiar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas às políticas de crédito.
  • Garantir conformidade com a legislação vigente e regulamentação aplicável do Sistema Financeiro Nacional.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em gestão e coordenação de políticas de crédito para pessoa física, preferencialmente em crédito consignado.
  • Vivência comprovada na análise e gestão de indicadores de risco e performance (inadimplência, PDD, NPL).
  • Experiência na definição de políticas de crédito, critérios de aprovação, limites, regras de elegibilidade e controles de risco.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado na análise de risco de convênios e empregadores privados.
  • Domínio dos conceitos de risco de crédito, análise de carteiras e modelagem/estudos estatísticos aplicados à tomada de decisão.
  • Entendimento da legislação de crédito consignado privado e regulamentação do SFN.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos em Excel avançado, Power BI e SQL.
  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, bancos digitais ou instituições financeiras inovadoras.
  • Vivência com crédito consignado público (INSS e servidores) será considerada um diferencial relevante.

Benefícios

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, Totalpass, vale-refeição e alimentação, e seguro de vida/auxílio-funeral.
  • Maternidade e paternidade: auxílio-creche, licença-maternidade de 6 meses, licença-paternidade de 20 dias, VA/VR no período da licença.
  • Previdência privada.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente.
  • Vale-transporte.
  • Fretado de ida e volta para Campinas e região (até 50 km). Reservas sujeitas à disponibilidade de assentos e rota. Estacionamento gratuito para quem vai de carro.
  • Folga de presente no mês do seu aniversário.
  • Dinheiro de volta no Cartão de Crédito: 1% de cashback sobre o valor total da fatura revertido na fatura seguinte.
  • Conta remunerada: CDB de aplicação automática, rendimento de 100% do CDI.
  • Isenção de tarifas de comunicação digital.
  • Crediário do Trabalhador: taxa e prazo diferenciados, disponível a partir de 6 meses de casa.
  • Antecipação do saque aniversário do FGTS.
  • Plano de saúde para pets (até 20% de desconto).

Superior Imediato: Gerente da Área

Alocação: Possibilidade formato híbrido (remoto e presencial no escritório em Campinas/SP)

Área: Finanças Corporativas

Oportunidade

Inserção em um ambiente dinâmico e multidisciplinar, mantendo contato nos clientes com profissionais de diferentes formações (advogados, contadores, engenheiros), especialidades (financeiro, comercial, RH, produção) e nível hierárquico (analistas até sócios), em empresas de diversos segmentos do mercado, gerando aprendizado, visão especialista e generalista de modelos de negócios, crescimento técnico e pessoal.

Missão Do Cargo

Atuar na execução técnica dos projetos de Finanças Corporativas, contribuindo para a elaboração de Diagnósticos Econômicos, Valuations, Estudos de Viabilidade, Business Plans, Pareceres e Laudos Econômicos, garantindo qualidade técnica das entregas e apoiando o relacionamento com clientes e o time sênior.

  • Manter atualizados os registros e controles dos projetos, de acordo com as políticas internas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação em Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou Engenharia;

  • Inglês intermediário a avançado.

Diferencial

  • 2ª Formação Superior relacionado à Economia ou Ciências Contábeis (CRC);
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria, assessoria financeira, auditoria ou corporate finance;
  • Conhecimento em avaliação de empresas, inclusive métodos complementares;
  • Experiência entre 3 e 5 anos em atividades relacionadas às atribuições da vaga;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI ou outras ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados.

Principais Habilidades Práticas

  • Modelagem econômico-financeira;
  • Valuation e análise de investimentos;
  • Análise de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Elaboração de relatórios e apresentações executivas.

Habilidades Comportamentais

Benefícios

Segmento

Agronegócio | Sementes | Biostimulantes | Tratamento de Sementes.

Buscamos um(a) Key Account Manager (KAM) para liderar a estratégia de entrada e desenvolvimento de mercado no Brasil, com forte atuação no segmento de sementes e tecnologias como coating e biostimulantes.   • Mapear contas-chave (multiplicadores de sementes, grandes cooperativas e grandes produtores) e definir planos de penetração por região;
  • Apoiar distribuidores e equipes técnicas no desenvolvimento e promoção de tecnologias (coating e biostimulantes);

  • Monitorar legislações brasileiras (especialmente de biostimulantes) e acompanhar movimentos e inovações da concorrência;
  • Calcular e demonstrar ROI para produtores (ganho de produtividade vs. custo de tratamento);
  • Garantir conformidade com exigências regulatórias e barreiras alfandegárias para produtos químicos e biológicos;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com influenciadores do setor (agronomos, consultores e líderes técnicos).

Requisitos

  • Formação de Engenharia Agrônoma;
  • Experiência sólida no mercado de sementes no Brasil, preferencialmente em empresas do setor ou indústrias de biostimulantes / tratamento de sementes / fitossanitários;
  • Conhecimento técnico em:
    • Fisiologia vegetal (emergência, estresse abiótico);
    • Tecnologias de tratamento e coating de sementes (aderência, fluidez, controle de pó);
  • Forte entendimento do mercado agrícola brasileiro:
    • Ciclos de cultivo;
    • Estrutura e influência de grandes cooperativas;
    • Concorrência e posicionamento de preços;
  • Experiência com ensaios agronômicos e validação de produtos;
  • Capacidade analítica para avaliação de dados técnico-econômicos.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com grandes contas (cooperativas, indústrias de sementes);
  • Vivência internacional ou reporte para matriz global;
  • Conhecimento em regulamentações brasileiras para produtos biológicos.

Idiomas

  • Português fluente (obrigatório);
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório);
  • Francês (diferencial).

Competências comportamentais

  • Alta resiliência e autonomia para atuação em território amplo e ciclos longos de venda;
  • Excelente capacidade de persuasão e comunicação, traduzindo dados técnicos em valor claro para diferentes públicos;
  • Forte habilidade de relacionamento e influência;
  • Perfil inovador, curioso e orientado a soluções;
  • Proatividade na adaptação de tecnologias globais aos desafios locais (solos ácidos, estresse hídrico, novas pragas).

Na Olmix, estamos comprometidos em ser um empregador inclusivo. Somos presentes na Europa, Américas e Ásia, e valorizamos a diversidade dentro do Grupo.

title: Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform
description:
Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world's top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world's top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Pricing & Order Platform, a critical system that powers how we price, structure, and execute deals across multiple product ecosystems.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, financial logic, and system architecture. You will be responsible for building scalable pricing capabilities, enabling complex deal mechanics, and expanding our order‑taking platform across both online and offline channels.

You’ll work closely with engineering, finance, operations, and commercial teams to ensure our platform is flexible, accurate, and scalable, while supporting increasingly complex business models.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the end‑to‑end product strategy for pricing and order‑taking systems (e.g., defining how a new product line plugs into existing pricing flows without breaking current deals)
  • Define and evolve pricing logic, deal structures, and financial flows (e.g., tiered pricing, bundled discounts, commissions, payment splits, financing fees)
  • Drive the expansion of the order‑taking platform across multiple product lines and channels (e.g., enabling the same order to be created via sales reps offline and completed online by customers)
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable system designs (e.g., turning “custom discount rules per partner” into a configurable rule engine instead of hardcoded logic)
  • Partner with engineering to design robust, maintainable architectures (e.g., defining when to use configuration vs. code, or when to introduce a rules engine vs. service logic)
  • Balance flexibility vs. control in pricing and deal configuration (e.g., allowing sales teams to configure deals without creating financial or legal risks)
  • Ensure accuracy, auditability, and reliability in financial calculations (e.g., guaranteeing totals match across UI, backend, invoices, and accounting systems)
  • Identify opportunities to automate and simplify operational processes (e.g., replacing manual deal validation spreadsheets with system‑driven validation rules)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align product capabilities with commercial strategy (e.g., enabling a new go‑to‑market model without requiring engineering changes every time)

Key Challenges You’ll Solve:

  • Designing a scalable pricing engine (e.g., supporting both simple fixed pricing and highly customised enterprise deals in the same system)
  • Managing complex deal configurations (e.g., combinations of discounts, add‑ons, financing, and conditional fees)
  • Ensuring financial correctness and consistency (e.g., avoiding rounding errors, mismatches between systems, or incorrect fee applications)
  • Balancing customisation vs. standardisation (e.g., preventing one‑off deal logic from polluting the core system)
  • Integrating online and offline order flows (e.g., syncing a salesperson‑created quote with a self‑serve checkout flow)
  • Reducing operational dependency (e.g., minimising reliance on ops teams to manually fix or validate deals)
  • Enabling fast experimentation (e.g., launching a new pricing model via configuration instead of a full release cycle)
  • Making trade‑offs between performance, flexibility, and simplicity (e.g., deciding between real‑time pricing calculation vs. pre‑computed values)

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building up world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognise the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We’re Looking For:

Core Skills:

  • Strong experience as a Product Manager in technical or platform teams (e.g., owned internal platforms, APIs, or systems used by multiple teams rather than just end‑user features)
  • Experience with complex systems (e.g., pricing engines, billing platforms, marketplaces, logistics systems, or payment flows)
  • Ability to understand and discuss system design and architecture (e.g., comfortable debating API contracts, data flows, service boundaries with engineers)
  • Solid grasp of data modelling, APIs, and rule‑based systems (e.g., designing entities like “Order”, “Quote”, “Pricing Rule”, and how they relate and evolve)
  • Strong analytical thinking (e.g., breaking down a pricing discrepancy into its root cause across multiple systems)
  • Experience translating ambiguous business needs into structured solutions (e.g., turning “we need flexible discounts” into a defined set of configurable rule types and constraints)

Differentiators:

  • Experience with pricing engines, billing systems, or financial platforms (e.g., worked on subscription billing, transaction fees, or dynamic pricing models)
  • Background in marketplaces, fintech, or e‑commerce platforms (e.g., handling multi‑party transactions, commissions, or complex checkout flows)
  • Familiarity with rule engines or configuration‑driven systems (e.g., tools where non‑engineers can define pricing logic or workflows)
  • Experience handling multi‑product or multi‑channel platforms (e.g., one platform serving different products, regions, and sales channels)
  • Strong understanding of scalability trade‑offs (e.g., knowing when abstraction adds value vs. unnecessary complexity)

Mindset We Value:

  • Systems thinker (e.g., understands how a pricing change impacts finance, UX, ops, and reporting)
  • Pragmatic (e.g., avoids over‑engineering while still planning for future scale)
  • Ownership‑driven (e.g., takes responsibility for revenue impact, not just feature delivery)
  • Detail‑oriented (e.g., catches edge cases like conflicting discounts or invalid deal states)
  • Collaborative (e.g., aligns sales, finance, and engineering around trade‑offs and priorities)

Why This Role Matters:

This platform sits at the core of the business. Every deal, every order, every financial outcome depends on it. Your work will directly impact revenue, scalability, and operational efficiency.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

title: Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform
description:
Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Pricing & Order Platform, a critical system that powers how we price, structure, and execute deals across multiple product ecosystems.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, financial logic, and system architecture. You will be responsible for building scalable pricing capabilities, enabling complex deal mechanics, and expanding our order‑taking platform across both online and offline channels.

You’ll work closely with engineering, finance, operations, and commercial teams to ensure our platform is flexible, accurate, and scalable, while supporting increasingly complex business models.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy for pricing and order-taking systems (e.g., defining how a new product line plugs into existing pricing flows without breaking current deals)
  • Define and evolve pricing logic, deal structures, and financial flows (e.g., tiered pricing, bundled discounts, commissions, payment splits, financing fees)
  • Drive the expansion of the order-taking platform across multiple product lines and channels (e.g., enabling the same order to be created via sales reps offline and completed online by customers)
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable system designs (e.g., turning “custom discount rules per partner” into a configurable rule engine instead of hardcoded logic)
  • Partner with engineering to design robust, maintainable architectures (e.g., defining when to use configuration vs. code, or when to introduce a rules engine vs. service logic)
  • Balance flexibility vs. control in pricing and deal configuration (e.g., allowing sales teams to configure deals without creating financial or legal risks)
  • Ensure accuracy, auditability, and reliability in financial calculations (e.g., guaranteeing totals match across UI, backend, invoices, and accounting systems)
  • Identify opportunities to automate and simplify operational processes (e.g., replacing manual deal validation spreadsheets with system‑driven validation rules)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align product capabilities with commercial strategy (e.g., enabling a new go‑to‑market model without requiring engineering changes every time)

Key Challenges You’ll Solve

  • Designing a scalable pricing engine (e.g., supporting both simple fixed pricing and highly customized enterprise deals in the same system)
  • Managing complex deal configurations (e.g., combinations of discounts, add‑ons, financing, and conditional fees)
  • Ensuring financial correctness and consistency (e.g., avoiding rounding errors, mismatches between systems, or incorrect fee applications)
  • Balancing customization vs. Standardization (e.g., preventing one‑off deal logic from polluting the core system)
  • Integrating online and offline order flows (e.g., syncing a salesperson‑created quote with a self‑serve checkout flow)
  • Reducing operational dependency (e.g., minimizing reliance on ops teams to manually fix or validate deals)
  • Enabling fast experimentation (e.g., launching a new pricing model via configuration instead of a full release cycle)
  • Making trade‑offs between performance, flexibility, and simplicity (e.g., deciding between real‑time pricing calculation vs. precomputed values)

More About You

  • You're passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You're motivated by building up world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You're creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We’re Looking For

Core Skills

  • Strong experience as a Product Manager in technical or platform teams (e.g., owned internal platforms, APIs, or systems used by multiple teams rather than just end‑user features)
  • Experience with complex systems (e.g., pricing engines, billing platforms, marketplaces, logistics systems, or payment flows)
  • Ability to understand and discuss system design and architecture (e.g., comfortable debating API contracts, data flows, service boundaries with engineers)

You will build scalable data models, support data‑driven growth, and work closely with other departments to ensure the company has the visibility required to optimize performance and drive strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high‑performance Power BI reports and interactive dashboards.
  • Build and optimize sophisticated DAX measures for complex business logic and KPIs.
  • Develop scalable data models (Star Schema/Snowflake) that ensure "one version of the truth" across the organization.
  • Implement Row‑Level Security (RLS) and manage workspaces, apps, and permissions within the Power BI Service.
  • Develop and optimize Power Query (M) transformations to ingest and clean data from diverse sources (ERP, CRM, SQL databases, Excel).

  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and perform root‑cause analysis on data quality issues.

Business Analysis & Insights

  • Strongly contribute to the department role of strategic partner to management from various departments and entities, to identify reporting needs and define KPIs.
  • Translate non‑technical business requirements into technical specifications for BI solutions.
  • Conduct deep‑ dive analyses to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for cost reduction or revenue growth.
  • Provide training and documentation to empower end‑users with self‑service analytics capabilities.

Strategy, Governance & Innovation

  • Establish and maintain BI best practices, including version control, documentation, and naming conventions.
  • Define the roadmap for data analytics, ensuring alignment with the broader business strategy and IT infrastructure.
  • Stay current with Power BI monthly updates and emerging AI/ML features to drive continuous improvement.
  • Lead the transition from static reporting to predictive and prescriptive analytics.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) is highly preferred.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analysis, ideally within a manufacturing or engineering environment.
  • Proven track record of delivering end‑to‑end Power BI solutions from data extraction to executive‑level visualization.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, NetSuite) is an asset.
  • Previous experience in a "hands‑on" senior role within an entrepreneurial or medium‑sized global organization.

Technical Skills:

  • Expert Power BI: Advanced DAX , Power Query (M), and data modeling expertise.
  • SQL Mastery: Strong ability to write and optimize complex queries to extract data.
  • Data Visualization: Mastery of UI/UX principles to create intuitive, clean, and impactful dashboards.
  • Excel: Advanced proficiency (Power Pivot, VBA is a plus) for ad‑hoc analysis.

Business & Soft Skills:

  • Analytical Mindset: Able to connect data points to real‑world business outcomes like margin analysis and product lifecycle analysis.
  • Communication: Excellent ability to explain technical data concepts to non‑specialists and senior leadership.
  • Project Management: Highly organized and able to manage multiple reporting projects simultaneously in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Problem‑Solving: Proactive in identifying data gaps and proposing creative technical solutions.
  • Strong written English and communication skills with high attention to detail.

What We Offer

title: Técnico(a) de Enfermagem - Setor Imagem / Vera Cruz
description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar nos setores da Imagem, Ressonância, Ultrassom, RX, Tomografia, Radioblação, Biopsia, Densitometria, Mamografia;
  • Desempenhar as atribuições de competência do Técnico de enfermagem conforme normativa do COREN, cumprimento das metas e protocolos assistenciais e das agendas de exames;
  • Efetuar registros pertinentes a função assistencial;
  • Orientar pacientes e familiares sobre rotinas do serviço, exames de imagens e cuidados após os mesmos;
  • Monitorar diariamente a agenda de exames;
  • Acompanhar o médico e monitorar os pacientes durante os exames de imagem;
  • Realizar a montagem de salas para exames de imagens e procedimentos;
  • Administrar contraste em rede venosa conforme protocolo médico, quando necessário;
  • Reposição de suprimentos de mat/med em posto de enfermagem e sala de exame;
  • Realizar o exame e garantir a qualidade do atendimento.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Residir em Campinas, Sumaré, Hortolândia, Valinhos, Paulínia ou Monte Mor.

Job Description Summary

The Director of Engineering leads a comprehensive organization of Design, Product, Test and Process engineers responsible for the end-to-end design of Large Rotating Machines (motors, generators and synchronous condensers), Transformers, Power Drives, Switch Gear and Complex Systems for a variety of industry segments. With design authority (under corporate standards), you will be responsible for major and complex assignments with long-term business implications, manage complex issues within functional areas of expertise, and be instrumental to the overall business strategy.

Job Description

Role Summary/Purpose:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) for the Power Conversion and Storage division in Latin America, the LATAM Director of Engineering will lead Engineering on Rotating machines (induction, DC, synchronous, PMM, synch reluctance, and other topologies) and Engineering of integrated electrical solutions (system design and integration, power electronics, automation, switchboards and installation) for products and projects within LATAM or exported from LATAM to many global regions, notably North America, Europe and the Middle East.

The role is both operational and strategic. It demands:

  • Transformational leadership skills – to guide the large organizational structure towards productivity, process standardization & maturity, speed and use of leading edge technology tools;

  • Technical depth – to foster an environment of creativity and innovative solutions, and to develop new business opportunities;

  • Seniority and executive presence – to interact with the customers in Latin America and abroad on complex engineering projects.

  • The role requires focus towards growth on the Latam region operation, and he/she will leverage the GE network, to drive product innovation, technology injections, structuring and cost-out through tools and processes in the areas of power electronics, automation, power systems, switchgears, rotor dynamics, vibration, electromagnetics, insulation, aero-thermo, structural, and both electrical and mechanical systems integration.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • The LATAM Director of Engineering directs a functional area of several engineering departments across the sites of Campinas, SP and Belo Horizonte, MG. Executes projects with great customer engagement and trust. Translates concepts, considers strategic options, develops tactics, and implements change. Creates programs in alignment with the external environment. Participates in cross-functional , multi-cultural teams.

  • Drives team performance to meet aggressive time and cost demands from our customers.

  • Develop, implement, and achieve performance KPIs.

  • Develop a roadmap for building world-class products and solutions, including electric machines, power electronics, switchgears, software and overall systems design capability.

  • Serves as technical expert in the technical community through demonstrated technical accomplishments which may include holding patents, component design and systems design experience, and strong knowledge of engineering design fundamentals.

  • Drives customer project execution and delivers on time and quality.

  • Leads and oversees quality engineering design, execution, and product safety; responsible for the oversight of the related sciences including materials and performance.

  • Provides guidance, leadership, mentoring and intervention, as necessary, to strengthen the discipline, quality, reliability and rigor of our engineering work.

  • Leads interactions with customers on technical issues.

  • Works with Power Conversion leadership to develop and build long term strategies.

  • Interacts with P&L engineering and technology leaders across GE to accelerate deployment of modern electrical and mechanical design tools and methodologies.

  • Works with P&L product leadership to reshape the overall Latam technical strategy and the organizational structure.

  • Provides leadership with high integrity and oversight of processes protecting intellectual property, export controlled and strategic technology.

Required Qualification:

  • Degree in Electric or Mechanical Engineering
  • Strong knowledge of Engineering Design Fundamentals and Engineering Processes
  • Extensive experience in mechanical and/or electrical systems design
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese mandatory
  • Industrial experience in relevant industry segments such as Oil and Gas, Power Generation, Mining & Steel and/or Marine will be a plus.
  • Subject Matter Expertise on Rotating Machines and/or Electrical Systems will be a plus.

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.

Nosso compromisso é garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Qual a missão do Cargo?

O Subscription Services Leader é a liderança estratégica responsável por estruturar, escalar e consolidar o Pool de Ofertas de Subscription Services da consultoria da Sensedia, transformando capacidades técnicas recorrentes em um modelo sustentável, previsível e orientado a valor contínuo para os clientes. Sua missão é consolidar o modelo de serviços recorrentes da consultoria como um dos pilares estratégicos de crescimento, garantindo previsibilidade de receita, aumento de margem e fortalecimento do relacionamento contínuo com os clientes.

Com forte visão de negócio e mentalidade orientada a serviços recorrentes, possui experiência na construção e gestão de modelos baseados em receita previsível (ARR/MRR), governança contratual e eficiência operacional. Atua como responsável por transformar competências técnicas em ofertas padronizadas, escaláveis e financeiramente sustentáveis.

Domina e acompanha de forma estruturada as principais métricas de SaaS aplicáveis ao modelo de Subscription Services, como ARR, MRR, churn, Net Dollar Retention (NDR), CAC, LTV, margem, expansão de base e indicadores de adoção e engajamento. Utiliza esses indicadores como base para a tomada de decisão, priorização e evolução do portfólio.

É responsável por liderar a estratégia do portfólio de Subscription Services, estruturar pacotes de oferta, modelos de precificação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e governança operacional alinhada com demais stakeholders da Sensedia. Desenha e desdobra OKRs, metas e KPIs relacionados a crescimento, rentabilidade e satisfação do cliente, garantindo acompanhamento disciplinado e execução consistente.

Essa liderança tem como objetivo estratégico atingir R$ 10 milhões de ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) em Subscription Services até o final de 2026, via transição de contratos atuais ou novos que se enquadrem no modelo de Subscription Services, assegurando crescimento sustentável.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Estruturar e escalar o Pool de Subscription Services com ofertas claras, padronizadas e replicáveis
  • Definir e evoluir modelos de precificação, SLAs e governança operacional
  • Estabelecer, acompanhar e analisar métricas SaaS aplicáveis ao modelo de serviços recorrentes
  • Definir e desdobrar OKRs, metas e KPIs de receita recorrente, margem, retenção, expansão e satisfação.
  • Garantir eficiência operacional, qualidade consistente e experiência positiva do cliente
  • Conectar estratégia comercial, capacidade técnica e execução operacional.
  • Evoluir continuamente o portfólio com base em dados, feedback de clientes e oportunidades de mercado

  • Trabalhar de forma transversal com Produto, Marketing, Vendas, Pré-vendas, Customer Success e Consultoria, assegurando que as ofertas sejam claras, executáveis e alinhadas ao plano estratégico da consultoria.
  • Ao estruturar e governar o modelo de Subscription Services com base em métricas, disciplina operacional e foco em cliente, essa liderança fortalece a previsibilidade financeira da consultoria, aumenta a recorrência de receita e sustenta o crescimento estratégico da Sensedia.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência com modelos de receita recorrente ou serviços gerenciados

API & Microservices: Proven experience in designing and implementing RESTful APIs, microservices architectures, and distributed systems.

Messaging Systems: Hands-on experience with messaging technologies (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, EventHub) and event-driven architectures.

AI Integration: Practical experience or strong interest in integrating AI solutions into development processes, including the use of prompt engineering and related GenAI techniques.

DevOps Practices: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (e.g., Git), and agile methodologies.

English Communication: Intermediate level in English to effectively read technical documentation and communicate with international teams.

Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering high-quality, performant code.

title: Especialista em Desenvolvimento Tecnológico Jr (Linha de Luz Sussuarana) | Technical Specialist[...]
description:
Job description

Para atuar na Linha de Luz Sussuarana do Laboratório Nacional de Luz Síncrotron (LNLS).

O(a) Especialista Técnico(a) atuará no projeto, construção, comissionamento e operação da linha de luz Sussuarana, dedicada a experimentos termomecânicos in situ e à síntese/processamento de materiais volumétricos sob altas pressões e temperaturas.

A posição é voltada a profissionais com forte formação técnica em instrumentação científica, engenharia mecânica, mecatrônica, materiais ou áreas correlatas, com experiência em integração de sistemas experimentais, automação e operação de equipamentos complexos. O(a) profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com pesquisadores da linha, contribuindo para a confiabilidade, segurança e desempenho da infraestrutura experimental e apoiando usuários durante a realização de experimentos.

English Version

To work in Sussuarana Beamline of the Brazilian Synchrotron Light Laboratory (LNLS).

The Technical Specialist will contribute to the design, construction, commissioning, and operation of the Sussuarana beamline, dedicated to in situ thermomechanical experiments and bulk material synthesis/processing under high pressure and high temperature.

The position targets professionals with a strong technical background in scientific instrumentation, mechanical/mechatronics/materials engineering, or related fields, with experience in experimental system integration, automation, and operation of complex equipment. The specialist will work closely with beamline scientists, contributing to the reliability, safety, and performance of the experimental infrastructure and supporting users during experiments.

Main responsibilities

  • Participar da montagem, integração e comissionamento de estações experimentais e sistemas auxiliares da linha de luz;
  • Operar e manter equipamentos para experimentos sob alta pressão e alta temperatura, incluindo dispositivos de ensaio termomecânico e prensas de grande volume;
  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas para automação, controle e aquisição de dados dos experimentos;
  • Preparar amostras e auxiliar na instalação de experimentos durante campanhas de usuários;
  • Apoiar, orientar e treinar usuários na operação segura dos equipamentos;
  • Executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva, garantindo estabilidade operacional e disponibilidade da linha;
  • Documentar procedimentos operacionais, protocolos de segurança e rotinas de manutenção;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de engenharia, TI e pesquisadores para melhoria contínua da infraestrutura.

English Version

  • Participate in the assembly, integration, and commissioning of experimental stations and auxiliary beamline systems;
  • Operate and maintain equipment for high-pressure and high-temperature experiments, including thermomechanical testing devices and large-volume presses;
  • Develop technical solutions for experiment automation, control, and data acquisition;
  • Prepare samples and assist in experimental setup during user runs;
  • Support, guide, and train users in safe equipment operation;
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to ensure operational stability and beamline availability;
  • Document operating procedures, safety protocols, and maintenance routines;
  • Work with engineering, IT, and scientific teams for continuous infrastructure improvement.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Física, Engenharia (Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Materiais, Controle e Automação, Elétrica) ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação Completa em Física, Engenharia (Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Materiais, Controle e Automação, Elétrica) ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Experiência com instrumentação científica, sistemas eletromecânicos ou equipamentos laboratoriais complexos;
  • Experiência em integração de hardware, sensores, atuadores e sistemas de controle;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de programação e aquisição de dados (Python, EPICS, LabVIEW ou similares);
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambiente multidisciplinar e de suporte a usuários.

Desejável

  • Experiência com equipamentos para ensaios termo-mecânicos, manufatura aditiva de metais, e prensas de grande volume;
  • Experiência em grandes instalações científicas (síncrotrons, fontes de nêutrons ou laboratórios multiusuários);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de vácuo, criogenia, fornos, hidráulica ou pneumática;
  • Experiência com normas de segurança e análise de risco experimental.

English Version

  • Bachelor’s degree in Physics or Engineering (Mechanical, Mechatronics, Materials, Control & Automation, Electrical) or related fields;
  • Postgraduate degree in Physics, Engineering (Mechanical, Mechatronics, Materials, Control & Automation, Electrical) or related fields;
  • Intermediate English proficiency;
  • Experience with scientific instrumentation, electromechanical systems, or complex laboratory equipment;
  • Experience integrating hardware, sensors, actuators, and control systems;
  • Basic programming and data acquisition skills (Python, EPICS, LabVIEW, or similar);
  • Ability to work in a multidisciplinary, user-support environment.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience with thermomechanical testing equipment, metal additive manufacturing, or large-volume presses;
  • Experience at large-scale research facilities (synchrotrons, neutron sources, or multi-user laboratories);
  • Knowledge of vacuum systems, cryogenics, furnaces, hydraulics, or pneumatics;
  • Experience with safety standards and experimental risk assessment.

description:
Somos especialistas em transformação tecnológica , unindo expertise humana à IA para criar soluções tech escaláveis. Com mais de 8,000 CI&Ters ao redor do mundo, já formamos parcerias com mais de 1,000 clientes durante nossos 30 anos de história. Inteligência Artificial é nossa realidade.

Importante : se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento de Lógica de Banco de Dados: Criar e manter scripts complexos, Stored Procedures, Functions e Triggers utilizando SQL e SQL Procedural Language;
  • Otimização e Tuning: Expertise no uso de ferramentas de Explain (db2exfmt, Visual Explain) para análise profunda de caminhos de acesso e métodos de join, visando a redução de consumo de recursos e tempo de resposta;
  • Manutenção de Performance: Executar e automatizar rotinas de manutenção essenciais, como RUNSTATS (atualização de estatísticas) e REORG (reorganização de tabelas e índices) para garantir a eficiência do storage;
  • Modelagem de Dados e Objetos: Atuar na concepção e alteração de tabelas, índices (B-tree, MDC, ITC) e views, além da gestão de Tablespaces (Bufferpools, Page Sizes), garantindo a integridade e a performance desde a camada física até o modelo lógico;
  • Troubleshooting e Concorrência: Diagnosticar problemas de performance em produção, como bloqueios (locks, deadlocks e timeouts), analisando níveis de isolamento e propondo melhorias estruturais ou de código para maximizar a concorrência.

Qualificações e Competências

  • Experiência com DB2 especificamente na versão LUW.
  • Domínio da ferramenta ERwin Data Modeler.
  • SQL Avançado: Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento procedural dentro do banco de dados.
  • Engenharia de Performance: Expertise técnica em criação e gestão de índices, particionamento de tabelas e compressão de dados.
  • Familiaridade com utilitários do DB2 (db2pd, db2top, db2advis) para monitoramento e diagnóstico.
  • Entendimento de como o banco de dados se integra ao pipeline de dados (ETL/ELT) e como otimizar o fluxo de grandes volumes de informação.
  • Domínio de utilitários de movimentação de dados em massa (EXPORT, IMPORT, LOAD e INGEST).

Certificações e Conhecimentos Avançados

  • Certificações IBM DB2 Administrator ou Database Specialist.
  • Conhecimento em integração de dados com ferramentas como InfoSphere - DataStage ou IBM MQ.
  • Experiência com Shell Scripting (Bash) para automação de tarefas no servidor.
  • Noções de infraestrutura (Storage, CPU, RAM) que impactam o comportamento do DB2.

Benefícios

  • Plataforma de aprendizagem contínua (CI&T University).
  • Plataforma online gratuita dedicada à promoção da saúde física, mental e bem-estar.
  • Curso gestante e parentalidade responsável.

title: Analista de Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
description:
Missão do Cargo: Construir e executar estratégias personalizadas para atrair, engajar e converter contas estratégicas (Key Accounts). Será o elo de conexão direta entre o Marketing e o Comercial, garantindo que nossas campanhas falam a língua dos tomadores de decisão e aceleram o ciclo de vendas.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Mapeamento de Contas: Identificar e segmentar contas-alvo (ICP) em conjunto com o time comercial e Marketing.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Realizar pesquisas profundas sobre as contas selecionadas (quem são os decisores, dores do setor e desafios do negócio).
  • Criação de Campanhas Personalizadas: Desenvolver estratégias de ABM 1:1, 1:Few e 1:Many, criando réguas de relacionamento sob medida.
  • Alinhamento Marketing/Vendas: Liderar reuniões de alinhamento com Account Executives para garantir que os leads gerados recebam a abordagem correta.
  • Personalização de Conteúdo: Escrever e adaptar copy para e-mails, landing pages, anúncios (LinkedIn Ads) e materiais de apoio focados em contas específicas.
  • Gestão de Ferramentas: Operar CRM e ferramentas de prospecção para monitorar o engajamento das contas e a evolução do pipeline ( RD Station e ZOHO).
  • Análise de Resultados: Acompanhar métricas como taxa de abertura, engajamento por conta, velocidade do funil e ROI de campanhas específicas.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‑technical teams Familiarity with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast‑paced, high‑volume environment A strong sense of ownership with a proactive approach to problem‑solving and process improvement Willingness to learn complex systems and contribute to continuous description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders. Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates. UX, Accessibility & Content Quality Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization. Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.G., alt text, content structure, readability). Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization. Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation. Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content. Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership. Performance & Optimization Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.G., Google Analytics). Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content. Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review. Qualifications & Skills 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments. Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices. Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues. Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance. Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows. Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time. Nice to Have Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes. Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments. Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists. Growth Opportunity This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Engineer Manager
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. - Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth. - Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development. - Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions. - Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value. - Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation. - Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope. - Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts. WHAT IT TAKES - Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment. - Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS). - Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members. - Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment. Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. - Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. - Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. - Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. - Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. - Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. - Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. - An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) Pj
description: Qual será o seu papel? Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas. Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente. Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes. Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem. Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa. title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Desenvolvedor (A) Kernel Sistemas De Alto Desempenho
description: Responsabilidades e atribuições Configuração, compilação e integração do kernel Linux utilizando ferramentas com o Buildroot e Yocto. Implementação de novos device drivers, adaptação de device drivers existentes para novas arquiteturas. Adaptação de bootloaders, como U-Boot e OpenSBI, para novas plataformas e geração da descrição de hardware em mecanismos como device tree. Colaboração com equipes de firmware e hardware para integração de kernel, bootloader, device tree e drivers à uma nova plataforma de hardware. Requisitos e qualificações Bacharelado ou mestrado em Ciência ou Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia Elétrica/Eletrônica ou áreas relacionadas. Proficiência na linguagem C e em assembly, com foco em sistemas de alto desempenho e em desenvolvimento para ambientes sem sistema operacional (bare metal) e em kernel-space. Ao menos 5 anos de experiência com a adaptação (porting) e bring-up do kernel Linux para novos plataformas, e implementação e adaptação de device drivers. Conhecimentos sobre a arquitetura e detalhes de implementação do kernel Linux, como gerenciamento de memória, escalonadores, processos, threads, etc. Experiência com ferramentas para geração de sistemas Linux, como Buildroot e Yocto, e ferramentas de emulação e depuração, como QEMU e GDB. Desejável : Conhecimentos da arquitetura RISC-V, em especial assembly para RISC-V, processo de boot, Supervisor Binary Interface (SBI), mecanismos de interrupção (CLINT, PLIC, APLIC), modelo de memória, mecanismos de sincronização e operações atômicas. Conhecimento em otimização de desempenho. Ajustes do escalonador, gerenciamento de memória e syscalls (chamadas de sistema) para utilizar os recursos únicos da arquitetura RISC-V. Conhecimentos e experiência com bootloaders e códigos de inicialização: UEFI, U-Boot, EDK II, Open-SBI. Contribuições em projetos de código aberto. Conhecimento em análise e otimização de desempenho. Ajustes do escalonador, gerenciamento de memória e syscalls para utilização dos recursos únicos da arquitetura RISC-V Experiência na caracterização (profiling) de desempenho de aplicações e uso de ferramentas como perf e eBPF.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.
